data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'baz', which means 'to expand, spread, or shine'. In Islamic tradition, the name Bazala symbolizes the expansion of joy and radiance in one's life. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bazala usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
